agent_explanation: No controller/gravity work explains the rise (controller disabled, work=0). Two oblique restitution bounces each increase the normal speed magnitude instead of scaling by e~0.998: vx -29.75 -> +30.95 at the thin vertical wall (energy 904.8->941.2J), then vy +26.51 -> -27.03 at the top boundary (energy 988.15->1003.0J, violating the bound). Likely cause: wall/boundary collision impulse or positional-correction adds energy on high-speed oblique impact (e.g. wrong restitution sign/scale or correction along velocity), compounding over bounces.
